purpose: functional verification of archiving a directory of a machine disk snapshot; no timing claim

cases.name: a stopped template machine's tree is archived exactly
the whole filesystem is archived and holds the tree
what cannot be archived is refused, each with why

refused.a file: "/srv/data/note" is a file, not a directory; read a file with /file
refused.dot-dot: "/srv/../etc": a path has no `.` or `..` in it
refused.no such snapshot: machine tpl-01 has no snapshot snap-ffffffff
